Name: HP Up
Description: Increases HP permanently by 10. Can be used to fill half your belly for today.

Name: Protein
Description: Increases Attack permanently by 5. Can be used to fill half your belly for today.

Name: Iron
Description: Increases Defence permanently by 5. Can be used to fill half your belly for today.

Name: Calcium
Description: Increases Special Attack permanently by 5. Can be used to fill half your belly for today.

Name: Zinc
Description: Increases Special Defence permanently by 5. Can be used to fill half your belly for today.

Name: Carbos
Description: Increases Speed permanently by 5. Can be used to fill half your belly for today.

Name: Ginseng
Description: Boosts the Move Power of a Move of your choice by 1. Can be used to fill half your belly for today.

Name: PP Up
Description: Increase the Maximum PP of a Move of your choice by 25%. Can only be used a maximum of 3 times on one move.

Name: PP Max
Description: Increase the Maximum PP of a Move of your choice by 75%. Can only be used once on a Move. Cannot stack with PP Up.

Name: Elixir
Description: Recovers all PP of one Move. Can be used to fill half your belly for today.

Name: Max Elixir
Description: Recovers all PP. Can be used to fill half your belly for today.
